name: Hearts of Zeal
label: Quest
description: Hearts of Zeal: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Why do I need a rare type of guano, you might ask. Well, for this experiment I want to see what effect two diametrically opposed chemical substances can have on each other, especially when both are combined with an ever-toxic agent to ensure the most... Ghastly results.
In the northeastern peaks of Tirisfal Glades lies the Scarlet Monastery. There the crazed disciples of the Scarlet Crusade congregate. Slay them and bring me their zealous hearts.
Our concoction will be most wicked!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you returned from the Scarlet Monastery? I'll need many hearts for this delightful experiment!
No doubt, Varimathras and the Dark Lady will be pleased to be rid of the Scarlet Scum as well...

clips.title: Completion
paras: My what an abundance of gore you have brought me, friend! Your efforts have been most excellent!
